name: verbs
description: The first-party cue verbs (#222; canvas primitives: Cue list `cues@1`): entries of cue.kind@1, each a recipe over the calling cue's signature, with its planted twin and its fixture.

cue.kind@1.name: create
cue.kind@1.description: An enter: each target's outline builds from its start to its end over its window, as a path build.

cue.kind@1.name: fade_out
cue.kind@1.description: An exit: each target's opacity falls to 0, to an offset, a point or a scale, over its window.

cue.kind@1.name: move_along
cue.kind@1.description: A move: each target travels the shape of the path `path` names, starting from where it is.

cue.kind@1.name: write
cue.kind@1.description: An enter: each target's text is written out over its window, its reveal running from none to all.

cue.kind@1.name: draw_then_fill
cue.kind@1.description: An enter: each target's outline builds over the first half of its window, then its fill comes up from dark.

cue.kind@1.name: fade_in
cue.kind@1.description: An enter: each target's opacity rises from 0, from an offset, a point or a scale back to where it is.

cue.kind@1.name: grow
cue.kind@1.description: An enter: each target grows from nothing at a point, its bounds' center unless `from` names one.

cue.kind@1.name: spin_in
cue.kind@1.description: An enter: each target grows from nothing at its center while it turns through `angle` degrees.

cue.kind@1.name: spiral_in
cue.kind@1.description: An enter: each target turns a full turn in from `scale` times its size, fading up over the first `fade` of its window.

cue.kind@1.name: by_letter
cue.kind@1.description: An enter: each target's text reveals letter by letter at an even pace over its window.

cue.kind@1.name: by_word
cue.kind@1.description: An enter: each target's text reveals a word at a time, its reveal stepping once per word over its window.

cue.kind@1.name: in_turn
cue.kind@1.description: An enter: each target fades up over the first half of its own window, so with a lag they come in one after another.

cue.kind@1.name: uncreate
cue.kind@1.description: An exit: each target's outline unbuilds from its end back to its start over its window.

cue.kind@1.name: unwrite
cue.kind@1.description: An exit: each target's text unwrites over its window, its reveal running from all to none.

cue.kind@1.name: shrink
cue.kind@1.description: An exit: each target shrinks to nothing at its bounds' center over its window.

cue.kind@1.name: indicate
cue.kind@1.description: An emphasis: each target swells by `scale` at the middle of its window and its fill takes the role `role`, then is back as it was.

cue.kind@1.name: flash
cue.kind@1.description: An emphasis: `lines` short rays grow out from each target's center and fade by the end of its window, while it lifts.

cue.kind@1.name: circumscribe
cue.kind@1.description: An emphasis: a frame `buff` outside each target's bounds draws around it and is gone by the end of its window, while it lifts.

cue.kind@1.name: passing_flash
cue.kind@1.description: An emphasis: a stroke `width` of its outline long runs once around each target's bounds and is gone, while it lifts.

cue.kind@1.name: wiggle
cue.kind@1.description: An emphasis: each target swells by `scale` and rocks `count` times through `angle` degrees, then is back as it was.

cue.kind@1.name: blink
cue.kind@1.description: An emphasis: each target goes dark and comes back `count` times over its window.

cue.kind@1.name: focus
cue.kind@1.description: An emphasis: a soft spot closes in on each target from four times its size, dimming to `opacity` and gone again, while it lifts.

cue.kind@1.name: broadcast
cue.kind@1.description: An emphasis: `copies` outlines of each target's bounds spread out to three times its size one after another and fade, while it lifts.

cue.kind@1.name: rotate
cue.kind@1.description: A move: each target turns through `angle` degrees, about its own place or, with `about`, a point it travels around on an arc.

cue.kind@1.name: swap
cue.kind@1.description: A move: each target and the item `with` names trade places over its window.

cue.kind@1.name: cycle
cue.kind@1.description: A move: each target moves to where the next target in the cue's list is, the last to the first's place.

cue.kind@1.name: morph
cue.kind@1.description: A change: each target's outline becomes the outline of the item `to` names over its window, points matched by arc length.

cue.kind@1.name: match
cue.kind@1.description: A change: each target's outline becomes the outline of the item `to` names over its window, its parts paired as `by` says.

cue.kind@1.name: count_to
cue.kind@1.description: A change: each target's text counts in whole numbers from what it shows to `value` over its window.

cue.kind@1.name: warp
cue.kind@1.description: A change: the warp of the group `warp` names comes in over its window, its mix keyed from 0 to 1.
